name: @kindly-note/lang-markdown
description: Markdown (CommonMark) language definition for kindly-note. Tokenises ATX headers, emphasis, lists, links, fenced code (with subLanguage for embedded code), inline code, blockquotes, and horizontal rules. Default-exports a deep-frozen LanguageDefinition with typed MarkdownExtensionPoints for downstream extenders (lang-markdown-gfm, MDX).
